name: vercel-cli-runner
description: Internal service, deployed as its own Vercel project (Root Directory = vercel-cli-runner). Not tenant-facing. Runs the real `vercel` CLI as a subprocess, authenticated with a tenant-supplied Personal Access Token, to do the things the OAuth Integration API structurally cannot: create a new project, create a Blob store, and provision a Supabase Marketplace resource. Cloudflare Workers (where itemlogs-website itself runs) can't spawn subprocesses, which is why this exists as a separate Node-runtime service that itemlogs-website's Worker calls over HTTP.
